segments.comment: cfgfiles.c config_erradd() raw-prints the offending rc line (pline("\n%s", origline) while the windows are not up) and then " * Line N: ..." messages. Patch 006 nomux_raw_putch() stores a byte only below column 80 and counts columns in bytes, so the 112-byte first line loses its tail and its 80th byte, which falls inside a two-byte character, decodes as U+FFFD. The second line puts two-byte characters in the error text.
